sources: Commercial (15): OpenAI text-embed-3-large/small + Cohere Embed v4 + Voyage 3.5/3-large + Mistral Embed/Codestral + Gemini Embedding 001/002
Open-source (25): Qwen3-Embedding 0.6B/4B/8B + EmbeddingGemma 300M + jina-v4 4B + NV-Embed-v2 + BGE-en-icl + gte-Qwen2 + SFR-Embedding-2_R + Stella + Snowflake Arctic + Jina v3 + E5
Leaderboards (11): MTEB-en v2, MMTEB Multilingual, CMTEB Chinese, MTEB Code v1, MIRACL, MTEB FR/JA/KO
_meta.notes: Qwen3-Embedding-8B sweeps MTEB-en v2 75.22 + MMTEB 70.58 #1 (displaces Gemini) + CMTEB Chinese 73.84 + MTEB Code v1 80.68. gemini-embedding-002 MTEB Multilingual v2 69.9 + MTEB Code 84.0 + MIRACL Code 84.0. EmbeddingGemma 300M on-device SOTA. jina-v4 4B multimodal MMTEB 66.49 (+14% over v3). MILCO MIRACL 72.30 ~14x smaller than E5-Mistral-7B (ICLR 2026). Mistral codestral-embed 85% code retrieval. Voyage 3.5 $0.06/M. text-embedding-3.5 does NOT exist. NV-Embed-v3 weights / bge-en-icl-v3 / snowflake-v3 / SFR-3 / gte-Qwen3 do NOT exist.
